offering_description.value: Sells cloud-based human capital management software for small and mid-sized businesses, covering payroll, HR, time and attendance, workforce management and tax filing. It is sold on subscription to employers and delivered through a hosted platform with added payroll and compliance services.

primary_products.value: HR and payroll software; workforce management software; time and attendance software; compliance software; fleet telematics software

primary_services.value: payroll processing; tax filing; compliance support; implementation and training

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and mid-sized employers across many industries

end_markets.value: small and mid-sized business HR; payroll; retail; healthcare; manufacturing; transportation

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring software fees per employee or per month; service fees: payroll processing, tax filing and implementation fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: hosted HCM platform sold to employers; service provider: payroll and tax filing services for employers

geography_served.value: US national: customers across the United States, with a presence in multiple states

specialization.value: related lines: HR, payroll, workforce management, compliance and telematics software sharing small business customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales teams selling to employers; partners / resellers: channel partners and accounting firms reselling the software

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payroll tax filing and employment, data privacy and security rules
